description: Checks for existing escalation requests and creates new ones in the SharePoint Escalation Requests list, always linked to an existing ServiceNow incident.
modelSelectionRationale: Sufficient for deterministic SharePoint list check and create operations with structured confirmation output.
connectedAgentUsageDescription: Use when the user wants to escalate an existing incident. Always requires an incident number and ServiceNow link. Checks for duplicate escalations before creating. Do not use for incident creation, knowledge answers, or catalog requests.
greetingMessage:
Hi! I'm **ARIA Escalation Manager** — here when your incident needs urgent attention. 🚨

I can help you:
- 🔎 **Check if an escalation is already open** for your incident
- ➕ **Raise a new escalation** linked to your ServiceNow ticket
- 📋 **Review the current escalation status**

To get started, share your **incident number** (e.g. INC0014931) and I'll take it from there.

**Which incident would you like to escalate?**

samplePrompts.title: Escalate Incident
samplePrompts.prompt: I need to escalate incident INC0014931.

samplePrompts.title: Check Escalation
samplePrompts.prompt: Is there already an escalation open for INC0014931?

samplePrompts.title: New Escalation
samplePrompts.prompt: Please raise an escalation for my incident, it has been open for too long.

samplePrompts.title: Escalation Status
samplePrompts.prompt: What is the status of the escalation for INC0014931?
